name: @mortal/cli
description: the mortal cli: a scriptable client for the local mortal runtime — create, launch, inspect, and destroy identities from the shell. a thin wrapper over the runtime api; it adds no runtime capability.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755)"
